anchor.meaning: C2-OH is the handover variant of the C2 'Env & Config' node; it adds no new alkane node.

term_collisions.hub_meaning: Modernize / Innovate / Prune maturity method (LEVEL1.md, *-mip.yml workflows)
term_collisions.rule: In this crosswalk and oid_federation.py, the handover's MIP is called SCHEDULE. Hub MIP keeps its meaning.

term_collisions.hub_meaning: C1-C14 alkane nodes are workflow nodes of one DAG, not repositories
term_collisions.rule: Lanes stay workflow nodes. A repository mirror needs its own owner before it is built.

00_CONTROL.title: Federation Master SSOT & Control Plane
00_CONTROL.note: Exact-head blob ids (census) and fail-closed OID binding (cicd_dag.bind_objects) are the HEAD pointer and manifest. Agent lease locks have no owner yet; see parked.

01_DROPBOX_IN.title: Asynchronous Drop-In Extension Bus
01_DROPBOX_IN.note: R2-W0 two-way GitHub and Drive bridge with broker. Not on master; do not build a second bus.

02_HANDOVER_LEDGER.title: Immutable Audit & Lossless Handover Ledger
02_HANDOVER_LEDGER.note: sha256-chained pulse ledger is the immutable append-only ledger; thread-handover tools land via #1171.

03_REPOS_MIRROR.title: 10-Core Repository Mirror & Alkane Lanes
03_REPOS_MIRROR.note: Alkane lanes are owned (C1-C14). The REPO_01..REPO_10 mirror is not; see term_collisions.

04_SLICES_OUT.title: Multi-Format Visualization & Data Slices
04_SLICES_OUT.note: DAG, SIPOC and Mermaid slices are owned. N2 DSM is produced by oid_federation.dsm(). Parquet telemetry has no owner; see parked.

TRACK_A_DMAIC_THEN_MIP.title: Process Governance First (DMAIC then SCHEDULE)
TRACK_A_DMAIC_THEN_MIP.note: oid_federation.wishbone() track A: transitive reduction (muda prune) then wave schedule.

TRACK_B_MIP_THEN_DMAIC.title: Mathematical Optimization First (SCHEDULE then DMAIC)
TRACK_B_MIP_THEN_DMAIC.note: oid_federation.wishbone() track B: wave schedule on the raw DAG, then prune.

TRACK_C_CONVERGED.title: Wishbone (2 -> 1) Bilevel Hybrid Amalgamation
TRACK_C_CONVERGED.note: Transitive reduction keeps reachability, so A and B give the same waves and makespan; wishbone() asserts it.
